findings: Not about the paper. The finite SurgeryData forms of (G3) assume `hS : IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy M S` (compact, C¹, spacelike) but every one of them follows from its LFSpears form with only `hS.cauchy`: (G3) needs of S only that it be a Cauchy surface of M (plus the spear data). Their types were kept, as the dispatch requires; a later target could weaken them, which would be a retype.
Not about the paper. E0Surgery.cauchy_facts (the compact form) is now unused in the strict library; it is kept because it is exported.

On the [r] question of T-btz-cauchy-step2-max (can the abstraction take a cusp predicate?): not as an arbitrary predicate. The (G3) argument over LFSpears is parametric in the family and in the covering, but each spear is a SpearSurgeryDatum and the proofs use its cusp through the datum's fields: Lemma 2.7's monotone height along ≼ (`spacelike`, via height_le_of_le / height_lt_of_le), continuity of the height off the axis, `rim` (C = C* at r = R, via rim_value / mem_graphSet_iff_of_rim), `above` (the cusp above the vertex level), `lim` (G → +∞ at the axis, in exists_pastSide via exists_lt_G_near_axis), compactness of the annulus (exists_bound_G_annulus), and `graph`/`shaft` for S in the chart. So Σ₀'s cusp can reuse this section verbatim if it is packaged as a SpearSurgeryDatum (a G with those fields); otherwise those seven properties are the interface a cusp-predicate abstraction would have to carry.
kb_proposals: When a shared structure is already exported (here E0Surgery.LFSpears), add a missing property as a hypothesis of the few lemmas that use it (hcovers) rather than as a field: a field retypes the structure and its constructor, a hypothesis retypes nothing, and each family passes its own field (`Dat.covers`).

If a corollary must keep a hypothesis its general form no longer needs (SurgeryData.isCauchySurface_sigmaStar's `hrem`), give the general lemma an `_of_arc`-style variant that takes the same binder, so the corollary uses its argument and the unused-variables linter (warningAsError) stays quiet without renaming the binder.
